name: Domino's
disclaimer_extra: Domino's publishes each ingredient separately for every size and crust, per the serving size that page states. Cheese is published twice — once for a cheese-only pizza and once for a pizza that also has toppings, since Domino's uses less of it — so pick the row that matches your order. Domino's notes that additional toppings change the values and does not say by how much, so a heavily loaded pizza is an upper bound.
blurb: Build your Domino's pizza by size and crust — every crust, sauce, cheese and topping priced per slice, with a slices-eaten control so you total what you actually ate.

categories.name: Crust
categories.note: Hand tossed crusts are brushed with garlic oil blend as standard. Domino's publishes it as a separate line, so add it unless you ordered the crust plain.

categories.name: Cheese
categories.note: Domino's uses less cheese when a pizza also has toppings, and publishes both figures — pick the one matching your order.
